source_context.item_title: No two owners use their boat the same way. That's why the Axopar 38 features a modular aft deck concept, offering multiple layouts designed for socializing, exploring, watersports and overnight stays. Choose the configuration that fits your lifestyle and make every trip your own.

source_context.item_title: The unique Gullwing Doors seamlessly unite the fore deck and front cabin into one seamless space. Open the doors to blur the boundaries between indoors and outdoors, creating an airy, social environment unlike any conventional cabin layout.

source_context.item_title: A shaded escape, a private workspace, a cozy lounge or a place to spend the night. The modular front cabin adapts to the way you use your boat, offering a comfortable and protected environment while staying connected to the outdoors through Axopar's signature Gullwing Doors.

source_context.item_title: The Axopar 38 is designed around how people actually enjoy life on the water. From paddleboarding and e-foiling to swimming, entertaining guests, relaxing at anchor or spending the night onboard, every space is created to support an active and enjoyable boating lifestyle. The boat becomes a gateway to experiences, not simply a way to reach them.
